purpose: Track older public pages that are technically reachable but still need coherence, fallback substance, consolidation or authored synthesis. This audit targets semantic gaps, not raw word count.
principles: Do not solve thinness by adding more links.
A dynamic page should still explain its subject before or when the data widget fails.
A substantive specialist page can still need work if its relation to neighboring project concepts is unclear.
Strong hubs should be left alone when additional prose would only duplicate material.
Legacy aliases and obsolete institutional routes should be consolidated rather than deepened.

issue_types.no_js_shell: Useful meaning disappears when data/runtime fails.
issue_types.isolated_substantive: Page teaches its local topic but does not explain how it differs from or connects to adjacent project models.
issue_types.legacy_wrapper: Route remains mostly for compatibility and should not become a second owner.
issue_types.duplicate_owner_risk: Several pages may explain the same concept without a clear primary reader.
issue_types.generic_hub: Page contains many categories but insufficient synthesis between them.
issue_types.strong_no_action: Page already has coherent authored substance; avoid gratuitous expansion.

Already has substantial mechanism-first synthesis and clear empirical/project boundaries.
Already long and internally structured; future work should improve compression/visual hierarchy rather than add prose.

next_wave.question: Audit whether speculative 11D/Axis physics is sufficiently separated from established M-theory and from symbolic Axis geometry throughout the full long page.
Re-review only for compression after specialist ownership changes; do not lengthen unless a genuine gap appears.
Check whether archive navigation has enough explanatory orientation for non-expert readers.
Assess whether alphabetical discovery exposes definitions/context rather than only labels.
Consolidate FBI legacy presentation into current Characters, Incidents & Associations ownership without enriching obsolete architecture.
Ensure CIA file pages explain the institution/data model before loading ledgers.
Audit named-being dossiers for provenance, role development, uncertainty and overlap with canonical character/archive owners.

long_term: Audit every top-level Dwelling and secondary public surface qualitatively, not by file size.
Add graceful static fallback to data-driven public pages whose main body currently depends on fetch/JavaScript.
Consolidate legacy redirect/wrapper routes so they remain compatibility surfaces rather than alternate owners.
Review older science pages as one layered scientific grammar: literal physics → measurable biology/psychology → information/network models → project metaphor.
Review older theology/mythology pages for terms that silently changed meaning after 2025–2026 and date those shifts instead of rewriting history.
Review long hubs for duplication and compression after specialist pages mature; sometimes coherence means removing repeated explanation.
Track semantic-gap status separately from Room maturity because a page can be inhabited yet still poorly integrated.
